entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Qeshm is a Sunni mosque located in Qeshm, in the province of Hormozgan in southern Iran. Completed during 1202 AH (1787/1788 CE), the Safavid style mosque is a tourist destination of the region. Jameh Mosque of Qeshm is a mosque in Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
